visitLine: Call and visit to Chipping Norton
heroLede: A missing or reversed part, or a poor solder joint, is hard to see by eye and costly once a unit is built. Here's what a camera check could look like on your board line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every part is fitted and the right way round, against the board design. A reversed diode is easy to miss at line speed.
labelLede: Solder bridges, dry joints and lifted parts are hard to catch by eye. The camera learns from boards your team has already passed and failed, and works alongside your existing inspection.
codeLede: Every board carries a serial and revision label. The system reads it and checks it matches the revision being built, so an old revision shows up straight away.
objectLede: Solder balls, offcuts and loose parts can end up on a board. The camera spots anything that should not be there before the board moves on.
